definitions: A digital notebook environment, often associated with Google's Gemini AI, used for developing, running, and sharing interactive code and text.
An interactive computing platform that combines code, text, and visualizations into a single document, specifically designed to integrate with the Gemini artificial intelligence model.
examples: She used a Gemini Notebook to prototype her new machine learning model.
The data scientist shared the analysis in a Gemini Notebook for collaboration.
Students learned Python by working through exercises in a Gemini Notebook.
